cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Outsmart the Room
cards.instruction: Turn every clue, deduction, and secret into a contest you must solve or control first.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've put 'greenhouse' above your 'greenhouse'. First to solve the treasure hunt.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Mine's under 'ruled out'. I already checked; it's empty.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Ruled out first, then. Read me the last clue before you write anything else.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It says 'where the fish live'. It's obviously the pond.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Don't write it yet. I want my chalk on the board before yours.
